task: Make every lattice-initiated host LLM run write attributed usage rows to .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl at the canonical launcher choke point, and productize the manual burn-attribution forensics as a read-only sweep over host transcript stores.
outcome: After M1, launching a reviewer/quorum/autopilot/probe host run through lattice appends correlated preflight+final ledger rows bound to storyId/agentType/phase/provider (plus reviewRunId/lane when given), with per-dispatch budget and concurrency caps refusing over-limit runs pre-spawn; after M2, lattice usage_sweep --since <date> prints a non-authoritative attribution report of codex/claude host sessions with token totals, story mentions, and cwd.
facts: The ledger and dispatch seam already exist and are default-ON: recordDispatchPreflight/recordDispatchFinal/recordDispatchFinalForProvider in core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts, wired only into dispatch_run leaf paths (lattice-dispatch.ts)
Reviewer launches, quorum host reviews, cross_host_review (codex exec -s read-only), autopilot runClaudeRepair (claude -p), and host readiness probes spawn host CLIs with NO ledger rows today

B-d8ef canonicalReviewHostLauncherSpec freezes per-host argv: claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json <prompt-file>; codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --ignore-rules <prompt>; agy --print <prompt> --print-timeout 30s --dangerously-skip-permissions

codex exec --json (codex-cli 0.141.0) emits a terminal turn.completed event with usage {input_tokens (includes cached), cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens}; --ephemeral means NO rollout file is written for canonical runs
agy print mode surfaces no per-call usage on any stable surface (verified via agy --print probe 2026-07-10 and earlier B-fbb6 probe): stdout is response text only
claude stream-json result usage is already parseable via parseClaudeCliOutput (anthropic four-field usage + served model)

The ledger schema already carries subagentId/threadId nullable strings usable for reviewer lane / reviewRunId binding without schema changes; record validator does not enum-restrict provider.name or decision.reasonCode, so antigravity unavailable finals and a concurrency_cap_exceeded reasonCode are schema-safe
review-runs.json rows carry reviewRunId (B-xxxx:RR-001), lane, storyId - the binding identifiers to share
~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl: first line session_meta has cwd/originator/source; token_count event_msg carries CUMULATIVE info.total_token_usage; desktop threads can be hundreds of MB
~/.claude/projects/<munged-cwd>/<uuid>.jsonl: assistant events carry message.usage four-field; ONE assistant message may span MULTIPLE events sharing message.id so naive summing double-counts
LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS fail-closed preflight guard exists (shouldBlockDispatch/recordBudgetBlock) and can be reused for the per-dispatch cap
cross_host_review verdict parsing reads plain codex stdout, so its argv stays unchanged in this story and its ledger rows record an unavailable final with a documented reason
constraints: Single-writer choke point: no second ledger writer path (usage-ledger execution plan completeness guarantee)
gateEvidence=false: no gate or lifecycle behavior may read usage data
core/usage-ledger keeps zero cross-module imports; wiring happens at callers
